note: ABI Bank's pre-contract information for its Visa Classic credit card (undated): 18% a year on purchases in lek or euros, and a yearly card fee of 1,250 lek after a first year at 625, which is introductory and not written. Tirana Bank's documents answered with a bot check and weren't read.
